title: Governance and Cost Management
description: Explore Control Tower, Config, CloudTrail, Budgets, Cost Explorer, and Savings Plans.

data.text: Governance means ensuring your AWS environment follows rules, policies, and best practices. AWS provides several services that help you monitor, audit, and control your cloud resources. These tools make it easier to maintain compliance, track changes, and understand costs.

rows: Tracks changes to AWS resource settings
Records API activity for security analysis
Aggregates security findings from AWS services

data.text: AWS Config records the configuration history of your AWS resources. It can alert you when a resource is changed outside of approved processes. For example, Config can detect if a security group is opened to the public internet without your knowledge.

AWS CloudTrail records every API call made in your AWS account. It answers the questions: Who did what? When? From where? CloudTrail logs are essential for security investigations, compliance audits, and operational troubleshooting.

terms.definition: A service that provides a landing zone for multi-account AWS environments with guardrails and account factories.
Records and evaluates configurations of your AWS resources over time.
Records API activity in your AWS account for auditing and security.
A visualization tool for understanding and analyzing your AWS spending.

data.text: AWS offers several tools to help you understand and control your spending. AWS Budgets lets you set alerts when costs exceed a threshold. Cost Explorer visualizes your spending patterns over time. Savings Plans offer discounts in exchange for a commitment to use a consistent amount of compute power.

data.title: Cost Management Services
items: AWS Budgets — Set custom budgets and receive alerts when you approach or exceed them.
Cost Explorer — Visualize your spending with customizable reports and filters.
Cost Anomaly Detection — Automatically detect unusual spending patterns using machine learning.
Savings Plans — Commit to a consistent amount of usage for significant discounts on compute.

data.title: Set a Budget Using AWS CLI
data.content: You can create a monthly budget to receive alerts when spending exceeds a threshold.
